[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained benefits of an aero kit for drifting, including improved traction, enhanced stability, better cornering speed, and reduced understeer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when selecting an aero kit: design and engineering, materials and quality, adjustability, and weight distribution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned popular aero kit manufacturers for drifting: APR Performance, Voltex, Rocket Bunny, Liberty Walk, and TRA Kyoto.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Affirmed that a good aero kit can make a significant difference in high-speed stability and cornering ability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Discussed the balance of investing in a high-end aero kit versus a budget-friendly option for the user's level of drifting.
